title: Pick a Card
book_title: How Search Decides What You See
author: Aaron Tay

voice.name: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural
voice.description: Warm, wry close-up magician talking to one person across a table; synthetic US English voice

lines.text: Pick a card. Any card.
Got one?
It was the one on top, wasn't it? Don't worry. That's the one most people pick.
Magicians call that a force. You feel like you chose... but the choice was made for you.
Search engines do it all day. And they've got better tricks than I do.
Trick one. Take a real research question, and add a word that doesn't exist. Anywhere. Shazamblix.
By Boolean logic, every single result should now vanish.
And yet... here they all are.
Trick two. About nine point four million results. Go on... try to see them.
A thousand. That's where it stops. So where are the other nine million?
Trick three. Ask in a full sentence... thirteen results.
Now just the keywords... thirty-five thousand.
Same question. Very different trick.
All three are real. They're in chapter one.
Magicians never reveal their secrets. And search tools don't always explain theirs, either.
So this free book shows you how tricks like these work. Boolean, BM25, embeddings, reranking, hybrid search...
and how to test a tool when nobody will show you what's under the table.
How Search Decides What You See. A free textbook.
Written by Aaron Tay.
Oh, and this video?
You didn't pick it either.
